# LiquiLens

LiquiLens is a bank and lender early-warning system. It uses public filings, funding structure, regulatory thresholds, and market signals to identify signs of distress. Public outputs are risk screens, not credit ratings or predictions that an institution will fail.

Canonical site: https://liquilens.in/
World-economy evidence map: https://liquilens.in/world-economy/

Capital-market evidence router: https://liquilens.in/capital-markets/
China-economy evidence router: https://liquilens.in/china-economy/

## World-economy evidence graph

The public evidence network covers a bounded financial-pressure chain plus revision-safe China economy and information evidence; it is not a complete world-economy database. Route the claim before retrieving the data:

- System funding: Seiche, https://seiche.info/, for US dollar funding, repo, reserves, Treasury cash, a granular USD money-market desk and a licence-aware global money-market atlas. Live coverage: https://api.seiche.info/api/v2/coverage
- Institutions: LiquiLens, https://liquilens.in/research/, for covered banks, NBFCs, MFIs and lenders. Live evidence status: https://api.liquilens.in/api/evidence/markets
- Market exits: Undertow, https://liquilens-undertow.com/, for provider concentration, market-depth evidence states and position-sized exit costs. Live public summary: https://api.seiche.info/undertow/x402/summary
- China economy and information revisions: Palimpsest, https://palimpsest.info/china/, for bounded bitemporal observations, release and collection clocks, revision identities, provenance, coverage gates and abstentions. Financial authority: none. Observation manifest: https://palimpsest.info/readings/china-econ-observations-latest.json

The machine catalog at https://liquilens.in/world-economy/evidence-catalog.json assigns each independent dataset a stable identifier, canonical landing page, machine-readable distributions, source lineage and evidence boundary. Cite each layer only for the claim it supports. An absent or unavailable input is not a calm signal, and a crawler or catalog entry does not guarantee an AI citation.

Use https://liquilens.in/money-markets/ when the user intent starts with repo, reserves, rates or funding; https://liquilens.in/capital-markets/ when it starts with depth, concentration, counterparties or exit capacity; and https://liquilens.in/china-economy/ when it starts with China releases, revisions, information availability or financial transmission. These pages are routers, not additional evidence authorities.

## Public evidence

LiquiLens publishes three types of historical evidence and keeps their claims separate. The status tokens and eligibility flags below are served by https://api.liquilens.in/api/evidence/markets and are authoritative:

- India: PERIOD_END_PROXY_CONSTRUCTION_PIT, a filing-availability-proxied construction-PIT diagnostic over 48 institutions. Validated-backtest eligible: false. Real-money eligible: false. The served headline reports 88.9 percent recall and 21.5-month median lead.
- United States: CURRENT_AMENDED_CONSTRUCTION_PIT over all 552 FDIC failures since 2008. Validated-backtest eligible: false. Real-money eligible: false. The current diagnostic reports 72.8 percent recall, 21.7-month median lead, and pooled 24-month AUC 0.854; misses are named.
- Europe: NAMED_CASE_FILES_CONSTRUCTION_PIT over seven sourced case files. Validated-backtest eligible: false. Real-money eligible: false. This is not a cohort-level performance estimate.

Status: VALIDATED_NOT_COMPLETE

One sealed ten-product replay pass contains 421,620 evaluations across 5,273 canonical events, producing 413,828 exactly bound gap rows and 51,870 root causes, alongside 82,556 robustness audit records. Named-event coverage is 32 of 47 national jurisdictions; 15 have no named event rows. The pass contains 4,191 verified event identities / 1,082 unresolved mappings. The baseline source ledger is 12 event-producing / 3 reviewed-no-event / 82 discovery-only, plus 1 supplemental event source. Three products have 4,146 genuine prospective forward score records; 0 of 7 requested products is eligible for retrospective backtesting. There are 14 robustness claim blockers. There were zero model changes.

This status validates the sealed execution pass, not the incomplete research definition. It authorizes no performance-improvement claim, model promotion, or production execution.

## Public products and boundaries

- Failure Radar reports failure-probability screens, regulatory action-zone distance, funding fragility, and market-implied distance to default where eligible inputs are available.
- Treat every market-distance value as API-dated evidence: `observation_at` (also served as `as_of` for compatibility) is the per-name observation date used by the freshness policy; `retrieved_at` is the separate capture clock; `liability_available_at` is the filing-availability clock used in the join—an explicit publication clock when present, otherwise the documented period-end-plus-60-day proxy; and `tier_authority` states whether all clock, admission, rights, and product gates permit the value to affect the tier. A daily-capable source is not proof that the served value refreshed today; absent fields leave freshness or authority unstated.
- Dated gate correction, 2026-08-10: the conformal alarm remains diagnostic/display only, its historical tier wiring is suspended, and `tier_authority` is false pending prospective revalidation. The gate at that correction was `CLOSED_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED`; https://api.liquilens.in/api/evidence/gates is the current machine authority.
- The MFI Risk Board reports disclosure-based readings for institutions with current vetted dossiers.
- Exposure Watch joins an organization's recorded counterparties to the existing public screens. It does not create a new institution score.
- Environment and market-context layers are displayed beside institution scores. They do not affect a score unless a pre-registered gate study passes.
- Missing or stale coverage is reported explicitly rather than rendered as calm.

One Bond Book field needs a precise reading. `tier1_negative_after_ugl_mark` is a boolean arithmetic flag showing that unrealized securities losses exceed Tier 1 capital on the bank's own filed figures. It is not a solvency finding and does not enter an institution score. Every flagged row carries `mark_qualifier`, and the payload defines the field in `mark_semantics`.

Private deployments add customer-specific cash forecasting, liquidity-risk, treasury, and credit workflows. Private-book claims require validation inside the customer's controlled environment.

The interactive demonstration at https://demo.liquilens.in requires sign-in and is available by request. It combines public evidence with synthetic operating data and should not be cited as a live customer book.

The public MCP and public evidence endpoints require no token. MCP v1.7.0 exposes 18 read-only tools and 4 discoverable prompts: today's exact full-text editorial, the Failure Radar, institution details, historical-evidence records, RBI registry and enforcement data, transmission signals, display-only crypto context, and record verification.

The hosted endpoint accepts the current MCP 2026-07-28 method-discovery contract and its declared legacy protocol versions. It publishes empty resource and resource-template catalogs explicitly rather than implying unavailable resources.

## Portable Evidence Carrier

LiquiLens Evidence Carrier v1 is the Apache-2.0 interchange contract used to preserve evidence identity across the product family. Its machine catalog is https://liquilens.in/protocol/catalog.json and its source repository is https://github.com/beepboop2025/liquilens-evidence-carrier. A carrier keeps event time, knowledge time, as-of time, source hashes, redistribution rights, product/version identity and an all-false execution, recommendation and credit-rating boundary. It can be projected into FDC3, CloudEvents, OpenTelemetry, OpenLineage, Arrow/Parquet metadata, flat rows, CSL-JSON and PROV-O without granting additional authority.

Canonical schemas:

- Full carrier: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-evidence-carrier-v1.schema.json
- Policy-redacted reference: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-evidence-carrier-reference-v1.schema.json
- Fleet Brief coordination envelope: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-fleet-brief-v1.schema.json
- FDC3 context: https://liquilens.in/protocol/fdc3/com.liquilens.evidence.schema.json
- OpenLineage facet: https://liquilens.in/protocol/openlineage/liquilens-evidence-facet.schema.json

## Trade Safety Receipt v1

Trade Safety Receipt v1 is an Apache-2.0, deterministic pre-trade control for AI trading agents, copilots and operator-owned order workflows. It binds one exact proposed order, accountable agent/operator/tenant/account identity, one operator-authored policy, request-bound product evidence and a short expiry to one of four outcomes: pass, limit, hold or unavailable. A pass means only that the exact request satisfied the exact policy at the receipt clock; it is not advice, approval, execution authorization or a promise of fill.

Seiche and Undertow are required in every policy. Seiche supplies system funding and bounded regime context. Undertow supplies requested-size exit-cost and venue-friction context. LiquiLens is conditional for a covered institution, issuer, lender or counterparty relationship and is normally not_applicable or context_only until a separately reviewed evidence profile is eligible. Product states, rights and event/knowledge/as-of clocks remain separate; they are not flattened into a universal risk score.

Canonical Trade Safety contracts:

- Human landing page: https://liquilens.in/protocol/trade-safety/
- Exact-order request: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-trade-safety-request-v1.schema.json
- Operator policy: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-trade-safety-policy-v1.schema.json
- Broker preview reference: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-broker-preview-reference-v1.schema.json
- Order-bound receipt: https://liquilens.in/protocol/liquilens-trade-safety-receipt-v1.schema.json
- FDC3 receipt context: https://liquilens.in/protocol/fdc3/com.liquilens.trade-safety-receipt.schema.json
- FDC3 intent fragments: https://liquilens.in/protocol/fdc3/trade-safety-intents.json
- Normative specification: https://liquilens.in/protocol/trade-safety/specification.md
- Infrastructure and adoption plan: https://liquilens.in/protocol/trade-safety/adoption-plan.md

The released Evidence Carrier 0.18.0 package and CLI can issue or verify local receipts; its Python package also exposes synchronous and asynchronous operator-side paper-order guards. Only a fresh, exact, HMAC-authenticated `pass` receipt can reach the protected paper callback. The offline read-only MCP server exposes receipt verification, not issuance, and the public gateway artifact remains a locked sandbox. Live mode fails closed until durable broker idempotency and uncertain-outcome reconciliation exist. No public hosted Trade Safety API, broker credential, preview endpoint or order-execution endpoint is advertised. An adopter makes the receipt mandatory by withholding raw order tools and broker credentials from the agent, then verifying the receipt inside the caller-owned OMS or gateway before its own action.

- FDC3 Evidence Inspector, LIVE SELF-HOSTED REFERENCE CONSUMER: https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/integrations/fdc3/evidence-inspector/ . Its upstream App Directory PR is submitted, not listed.

The canonical status, exact commands, immutable digests and public receipts are in https://liquilens.in/protocol/catalog.json. A repository artifact, submitted listing, fetched page or catalog record is not promoted to a live consumer path without a matching external receipt.

The protocol and reference implementation are public under Apache-2.0. The license does not grant rights to third-party provider data placed inside a carrier. Restricted or unknown redistribution rights fail closed.

The CLI v0.5.0 runs the India and US boards in a terminal, emits JSON or pipe-safe tables for automation, and caches the last good response for offline use. Run it without a persistent install with `npx liquilens`. Use `npx liquilens --record` for the three-market status ledger and `--record --json` to preserve the served evidence payload exactly.

The first paid door is a named-list software seat at https://liquilens.in/access/: up to 25 public institution names on the live India Failure Radar or the served US FDIC board, a monthly generated pack, and flip alerts. Indian legal names or slugs and US legal names or FDIC certs are in scope. A European name that is not on those boards stays uncovered; Europe is seven named case files, not a monthly named-list book. No customer loan book is required. There is no list price on the public site. Write mrinal@liquilens.in. Private-book validation remains a six-week paid parallel pilot, scoped in the same reply, and is the last rung.

The scoring boundary is fixed: generative features may explain served evidence, but the deterministic screening policy scores institutions. Historical-diagnostic eligibility is reported separately and never inferred from the presence of a score. A grounded answer that cannot verify its figures against served payloads is refused.

## Public-good house (grants, not invoices)

Palimpsest, Evidence Signal, and NarcoScope are free public goods. They observe and seal. They do not size financial risk and they are not named-list software.

- Funding page: https://palimpsest.info/fund.html
- Evidence Signal: https://t.me/EvidenceSignalDesk
- Palimpsest 1.9.3: https://palimpsest.info/ — six anonymous public read-only MCP tools, four visible prompts and one metadata-only publication-rights resource at https://api.seiche.info/palimpsest/mcp. The catalog publishes exact deployment and official MCP Registry receipt URLs and hashes; initialize the remote and compare serverInfo.version for live authority: https://palimpsest.info/.well-known/ai-catalog.json. Rights-denied economic evidence stays explicitly unavailable and cannot become a zero, neutral, healthy or directional result.
- NarcoScope: https://narcoscope.com/

This is a historical replay, not current news and not a forecast. Rupee Co-operative Bank’s record shows why a balance-sheet screen must separate a filing-period signal, a market-price signal, and an absence of scoreable evidence.

Altico’s disclosed commercial-paper reliance was a liability-side vulnerability in the historical record. The finding is a filing-period signal, not a market-price call or a model-derived failure forecast.

This historical replay finds that Abhyudaya Co-operative Bank entered an RBI action zone on NNPA in FY2021, well before its event date. It is a disclosure-timed signal, not a forecast, a market-price verdict, or a calibrated probability of failure.

A fragile wholesale-leverage reading preceded Sambandh Finserve’s recorded default.
